names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 31 martie, «Sfântul Mucenic Veniamin, diaconul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 31 Μαρτίου, «… Βενιαμίν ο Διάκονος …», with the rank word left off.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 406, «Священномученик Вениамин Персидский», with the rank word left off. The day line gives «Вениамина диакона» and the two lives behind the page head him «Мученик Вениамин диакон».

Read out of the body of the Ohrid Prologue's third entry for the Julian 31 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Његов ђакон свети Венијамин буде пуштен од мучитеља под условом да више не проповеда Јеванђеље.“ The rank word ђакон and Свети are left off, and the clause gives him no epithet and no city, so the bare forename is all the page gives him.

feast.note: His name page keeps two days, «31 марта» — the day the Greek and the Romanian keep him on, with Abdas bishop of Persia — and this one. One row per church is the schema, so the March day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 октября ст. ст. — «Мч. Вениамина диакона (421-424).»
source.note: No rank is read onto this line. The day prints two icons and both stand in its first paragraph: a polyeleos before the Iveron icon of the Theotokos, and the plain service, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all, before the company of 251. Neither reaches a later line. The day's readings do name one further polyeleos service, and it is Thaddeus of Tver's, not this one's.

attestations.note: The same man the Greek and the Romanian keep on 31 March, and his own index page proves it: it keeps both days and links the life of «Священномученики Авда, епископ Персидский, и Вениамин диакон», which is the 31 March commemoration. What the Russian adds is the place, Susa, the king — Yazdegerd, whose reign it dates 401 to 402 — the thirty days between Abdas's beheading and the others' execution, and the manner of his own death, which neither of the other calendars gives.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 31 martie — «Sfântul Mucenic Veniamin, diaconul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 31ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Αυδάς επίσκοπος Περσίας, Βενιαμίν ο Διάκονος και οι μαζί μ' αυτούς εννέα Μάρτυρες και άλλοι πολλοί Άγιοι, που μαρτύρησαν στην Περσία»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 442)» and separates his persecution from the bishop Abda's by thirty years: after the persecution of 412 in which Abda and nine leading Christians died, «Μετά 30 χρόνια, κινήθηκε νέος διωγμός κατά των χριστιανών», and among those who were sacrificed in it were Hormisdas of noble birth and «ο διάκονος Βενιαμίν ο μεγαλομάρτυρας». It says the Church appointed the memory of all of them, known and unknown, together with the bishop Abda's, to show that the heroes of the faith have a common honour in heaven. Its couplet for him names the instrument: «Ἀθλητικῷ κλυστῆρι, τῷ πάλῳ λέγω, Πᾶν Βενιαμὶν ψυχικὸν κενοῖ βάρος» — with a contender's clyster, the stake I mean, Benjamin empties out every burden of the soul. It prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 13.04.2026 (31. март ст. ст.) — „Свештеномученик Авда, епископ града Сузе“ … „Његов ђакон свети Венијамин буде пуштен од мучитеља под условом да више не проповеда Јеванђеље.“

attestations.note: The day's third entry, headed for Abda and naming this man in its own body, so the citation carries the heading and then his own clause, as the companions of the Julian 10, 19 and 29 March did. He is the man this folder already holds: the deacon of the Persian bishop, released on the condition that he preach no more, unable to keep to it, seized again and killed. **A fourth reading of his year, and it was not taken**: the entry says he died „на три године после светог Авде, 421. године“, three years after Abda and in 421, which falls inside the «between 418 and 442» this folder carries and is narrower than it, so the interval was not narrowed. It is worth noting against the other three readings that this page's 421 is three years after its own 418 for Abda, so the two years are one reckoning and not two. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion. The stored form Венијамин folds with nothing: no other folder in the corpus holds a Serbian form of this spelling.

death.note: Three readings, and nothing chooses between them, so the interval carries all three. saint.gr heads him «Αγιος Βενιαμιν ο Διακονος (; - 442)» and reaches 442 by putting his persecution «Μετά 30 χρόνια» after the persecution of 412. days.pravoslavie.ru disagrees with itself: its day line for 13 October prints «Мч. Вениамина диакона (421-424)», while the life its own index page links closes «Священномученики скончались в 418 или 424 гг. в древнем персидском городе Сузе». The folder held 442 alone before the Russian was read.
